oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: create_config returns the DEFAULTS dict object directly
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: returned config shares mutable state with the module-level DEFAULTS
mechanism_steps: create_config returns DEFAULTS by reference (not a copy)
caller mutates the returned dict
mutation modifies the global DEFAULTS object
subsequent calls to create_config return the mutated DEFAULTS
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: later config reads observe values corrupted by earlier callers
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: DEFAULTS is being mutated elsewhere in the codebase rather than through shared reference aliasing in create_config
